short.en: New Zealand ratifies the Statute of Westminster and thus becomes independent of legislative control by the United Kingdom.
short.zh: 新西兰批准《威斯敏斯特规约》，从而摆脱了联合王国的立法控制。

short.en: In every religion there is love, yet love has no religion.
AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.
short.zh: 该行业中心旧金山的人工智能员工担心该行业过热。

short.en: With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
Keep your voice down, someone might hear us.
short.note: keep down 压低声量；might 弱读。

short.en: BBC News Mundo’s Rafael Rojas visits the real-life Miami locations that inspired Vice City, GTA 6’s fictionalised setting.
short.zh: BBC News Mundo 的拉斐尔·罗哈斯 (Rafael Rojas) 探访了现实生活中的迈阿密地点，这些地点为《侠盗猎车手 6》的虚构场景《罪恶都市》提供了灵感。

short.en: The Cocos Islands are transferred from the control of the United Kingdom to that of Australia.
short.zh: 科科斯群岛从英国的管辖下移交给澳大利亚。

short.en: This shirt doesn't fit me anymore, it's too tight.
short.zh: 这件衬衫我穿不下了，太紧。
short.note: fit 合身；anymore 否定句中“再”；tight 双元音 /aɪ/。

short.en: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.
short.zh: 该判决是在纽约历时数月的审判之后作出的。

short.en: A Beechcraft 1900 and a Beechcraft King Air collide at Quincy Regional Airport in Quincy, Illinois, killing 14.
short.zh: 一架 Beechcraft 1900 和一架 Beechcraft King Air 在伊利诺伊州昆西地区机场相撞，造成 14 人死亡。

short.en: One of the greatest diseases is to be nobody to anybody.
You live by what you thrill to, and there's the end of it.
World War II: HMS Barham is sunk by a German torpedo.
short.zh: 第二次世界大战：英国皇家海军“巴勒姆”号战列舰被德国鱼雷击沉。

short.en: Rose, who died in 2024, was given a lifetime ban from the sport for betting on games but was reinstated last year.
The little rabbit hopped across the green meadow.
short.zh: 小兔子跳过了绿色的草地。
short.note: rabbit 双写 b；hopped 的 /pt/ 尾音轻收；meadow 重音在前。

short.en: The Garinagu arrive at British Honduras (present-day Belize).
Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.
short.zh: 产油国的利益、美国的抵制以及金融争端可能破坏了气候谈判。

short.en: Everybody's life is either rewarding or an example.
Only those who do nothing at all make no mistakes.
You can easily judge the character of a man by how he treats those who can do nothing for him.

long.en: Begin of the Russo-Turkish War of 1710–1713, after tensions between the two states escalate as the Ottomans provide shelter to King Charles XII of Sweden in their fortress of Bender.
World War II: The Deutsche Opernhaus on Bismarckstraße in the Berlin neighborhood of Charlottenburg is destroyed. It will eventually be rebuilt in 1961 and be called the Deutsche Oper Berlin.
long.zh: 第二次世界大战：位于柏林夏洛滕堡区俾斯麦大街的德国歌剧院被毁。剧院最终于1961年重建，并更名为柏林德国歌剧院。

long.en: When I was a child, summer felt endless, and every afternoon seemed to last forever. We would run outside after lunch, play games with neighbors, and only come home when the streetlights turned on and our parents called us in.
long.zh: 小时候夏天仿佛没有尽头，每个下午都长得过不完。午饭后我们就跑出去和邻居玩游戏，直到路灯亮起、父母喊我们回家才肯进门。
long.note: would 表过去习惯；endless 后缀 -less；neighbors 美音卷舌。
